rules.statement: The existence of an agreement for payment may be established by implication from the circumstances of a case, and proof of such an agreement is not necessarily barred by the absence of a notarially executed instrument.
rules.supporting_quote: "I see no reason why the existence of an agreement for payment may not be established by implication from the circumstances of a case. There is nothing in the case of Mudianse v. Mudianse which compels us to hold that proof of an agreement of this character is barred by the absence of a notarially executed instrument."
